system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response: As of August 2026, the interest rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code was last set on January 1, 2023, at 3% per annum. There has been no official adjustment to this rate as of that date.
